name: Declared Summary Reuse-Attempt Routes
description: C06/C11 route demo: each language's existing summary producer emits a manifest and the matching reuse-attempt route records versioned lineage; a changed TypeScript dependency is freshly derived and a timed-out run selects nothing.

harness_contract.intent: Run the Go, Rust, Solidity and TypeScript summary producers, pass each generated manifest to its reuse-attempt route, show stale TypeScript data refreshed for a changed dependency, and show a timed-out attempt selecting nothing.
artifact_contracts: Read inputs: the existing demo_counter fixtures under scenarios/go_summaries, scenarios/rust_summaries, scenarios/sol_summaries and scenarios/ts_summaries, plus the sibling mumei-agent producer and reuse-attempt routes.
The Go helper is built under {output_dir}/bin when a Go toolchain is available; dependent Go steps are skipped if the optional helper step is unavailable.
Rust, Solidity and TypeScript analyzers run in-process. All manifests and reports are generated by live route commands; no fixture payloads are used.

Each successful reuse-attempt report must have the route's versioned schema, outcome exited, exit_code 0 and a selected_result; source, manifest and Go helper bytes are hashed before and after the route.

The stale TypeScript step edits only an output-directory copy of demo_counter.ts, then compares the reuse-attempt stdout digest with fresh producer output for that copy and the unedited attempt's stdout digest.
The timeout step uses --attempt-timeout 1 and requires outcome timed_out with no selected_result or candidate.
notes: The reports record summary-route attempt lineage and selected-output fingerprints only.
The stale TypeScript route's normalized.stdout.sha256 matches the fresh ts-summaries output for the edited copy and differs from the unedited route output.
The Go route follows go_summaries' optional helper build convention; no new source fixture is added.
budget_policy_fingerprint is summaries-reuse-attempt-v1 for deterministic route invocation.

steps.name: Provision: build the Go summary helper
steps.command: mkdir -p {output_dir}/bin && cd {mumei_agent_repo}/tools/go-types && GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off GOWORK=off go build -o {output_dir}/bin/go-types . && echo 'go-types helper built'
steps.artifact_contract: Build the go-types helper into {output_dir}/bin/go-types when Go is available; otherwise this optional step and its dependents are skipped.
steps.verifier_gate: The provisioned helper is available to the Go producer and reuse-attempt routes.

steps.name: Produce: Go summary manifest
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent go-summaries --source {root_dir}/scenarios/go_summaries/demo_counter.go --go-types {output_dir}/bin/go-types --output {output_dir}/go_manifest.json --timeout 30 > {output_dir}/go_produce.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/go_produce.log; cat {output_dir}/go_manifest.json; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c 'import json,sys; assert json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["schema_version"] == "mumei.go-scalar-parameter-deps/v1"' {output_dir}/go_manifest.json
steps.artifact_contract: go_manifest.json is emitted by go-summaries for the existing demo_counter.go fixture.
steps.verifier_gate: The Go producer exits 0 and emits the declared Go summary manifest.

steps.name: Attempt: Go reuse route with its produced manifest
steps.command: before=$(sha256sum {root_dir}/scenarios/go_summaries/demo_counter.go {output_dir}/go_manifest.json {output_dir}/bin/go-types) && {mumei_agent_python} -m agent go-summaries-reuse-attempt --source {root_dir}/scenarios/go_summaries/demo_counter.go --go-types {output_dir}/bin/go-types --manifest {output_dir}/go_manifest.json --attempt-timeout 30000 --timeout 30 > {output_dir}/go_reuse_attempt.json 2> {output_dir}/go_reuse_attempt.stderr; rc=$?; after=$(sha256sum {root_dir}/scenarios/go_summaries/demo_counter.go {output_dir}/go_manifest.json {output_dir}/bin/go-types); cat {output_dir}/go_reuse_attempt.json; cat {output_dir}/go_reuse_attempt.stderr; test $rc -eq 0 && test "$before" = "$after" && python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert r["schema_version"] == "mumei.go-summaries-reuse-attempt-report/v1"; n=r["normalized"]; assert n["outcome"] == "exited" and n["exit_code"] == 0; assert r["sequence"]["selected_result"] is not None and "candidate" in r; print("Go result selected with declared input bytes unchanged")' {output_dir}/go_reuse_attempt.json
steps.artifact_contract: The Go reuse-attempt report records outcome exited and a selected_result only while the source, manifest and helper bytes remain unchanged.
steps.verifier_gate: The route exits 0, emits the Go reuse-attempt report, and the declared input hashes match before and after dispatch.

steps.name: Stale manifest: changed TypeScript dependency is freshly derived
steps.command: python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; src=Path("{root_dir}/scenarios/ts_summaries/demo_counter.ts"); dst=Path("{output_dir}/ts_stale_demo_counter.ts"); text=src.read_text(); old="return a + b;"; assert text.count(old)==1; dst.write_text(text.replace(old,"return a;")); print("edited TypeScript fixture copy")' && {mumei_agent_python} -m agent ts-summaries {output_dir}/ts_stale_demo_counter.ts > {output_dir}/ts_stale_fresh_manifest.json 2> {output_dir}/ts_stale_fresh_manifest.stderr && {mumei_agent_python} -m agent ts-summaries-reuse-attempt {output_dir}/ts_stale_demo_counter.ts --manifest {output_dir}/ts_manifest.json --attempt-timeout 30000 > {output_dir}/ts_stale_attempt.json 2> {output_dir}/ts_stale_attempt.stderr; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/ts_stale_attempt.json; cat {output_dir}/ts_stale_fresh_manifest.stderr; cat {output_dir}/ts_stale_attempt.stderr; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c 'import hashlib,json,sys; from pathlib import Path; report=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()); fresh=hashlib.sha256(Path(sys.argv[2]).read_bytes()).hexdigest(); baseline=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[3]).read_text())["normalized"]["stdout"]["sha256"]; actual=report["normalized"]["stdout"]["sha256"]; assert report["schema_version"]=="mumei.ts-summaries-reuse-attempt-report/v1"; assert report["normalized"]["outcome"]=="exited" and report["normalized"]["exit_code"]==0; assert report["sequence"]["selected_result"] is not None; assert actual==fresh and actual!=baseline; print("stale TypeScript summary refreshed; attempt stdout matches fresh producer and differs from unedited run")' {output_dir}/ts_stale_attempt.json {output_dir}/ts_stale_fresh_manifest.json {output_dir}/ts_reuse_attempt.json
steps.artifact_contract: The edited source's reuse-attempt stdout digest equals fresh ts-summaries output for that copy and differs from the unedited run, so the changed summary is freshly derived.
steps.verifier_gate: The attempt exits 0 with outcome exited and selected_result; the byte digest matches fresh producer output and differs from the original source's attempt output.

steps.name: Refusal: a timed-out reuse attempt selects no result
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent ts-summaries-reuse-attempt {root_dir}/scenarios/ts_summaries/demo_counter.ts --manifest {output_dir}/ts_manifest.json --attempt-timeout 1 > {output_dir}/timeout_attempt.json 2> {output_dir}/timeout_attempt.stderr; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/timeout_attempt.json; cat {output_dir}/timeout_attempt.stderr; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert r["schema_version"] == "mumei.ts-summaries-reuse-attempt-report/v1"; assert r["normalized"]["outcome"] == "timed_out"; assert r["sequence"].get("selected_result") is None and "candidate" not in r; print("timed-out reuse attempt selected nothing")' {output_dir}/timeout_attempt.json
steps.artifact_contract: timeout_attempt.json records outcome timed_out with no selected_result or candidate key.
steps.verifier_gate: The timed-out reuse attempt exits 0 as a lineage report and selects no result.
